results.snippet:
Authorities in Nigeria’s Niger State said that the vehicle involved in a fatal crash on the Minna–Bida road was not carrying out duties as part of Governor Mohammed Umaru Bago’s convoy. Five people were killed in the accident, including four students of the Federal University of Technology and a driver who worked in the governor’s administration.
